title: MASTA: A Feedback-Scheduled Multi-Agent System for End-to-End Tamarin Modeling and Analysis
abstract: arXiv:2611.20671v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Tamarin-based formal verification of security protocols requires expert-authored multiset rewriting rules and temporal-logic lemmas. Translating a natural-language protocol description into a complete formal model with an LLM is hard because syntactic, reachability, and property-level errors compound across the multi-step modeling process, and a single agent that both authors and self-evaluates cannot reliably localize them. We present MASTA, a multi-agent system that addresses these difficulties through three innovations. First, an operational--evaluative role decomposition assigns rule modeling to an Architect, property modeling to an Auditor, and pure dispatch to a dedicated Arbiter that holds no authoring duties. Second, the Arbiter implements a Tamarin-anchored scheduler that dispatches the next agent based on the latest verifier verdict and routes problem-tagged fixes through a modification list, with a six-class problem taxonomy

translated_title: MASTA：一个用于端到端Tamarin建模与分析的反馈调度多智能体系统
translated_abstract: 基于Tamarin的安全协议形式化验证需要专家编写的多重集重写规则和时序逻辑引理。使用大语言模型将自然语言协议描述翻译为完整的形式化模型十分困难，因为语法、可达性和属性层面的错误会在多步骤建模过程中不断复合累积，而一个既负责撰写又负责自我评估的单一智能体无法可靠地定位这些错误。我们提出了MASTA，一个通过三项创新来应对这些困难的多智能体系统。首先，操作-评估角色分解将规则建模分配给架构师，将属性建模分配给审计员，并将纯粹的调度任务分配给一个不承担任何撰写职责的专门仲裁者。其次，仲裁者实现了一个以Tamarin为锚定的调度器，根据最新的验证器判定结果来调度下一个智能体，并通过修改列表路由带有问题标签的修复任务，采用六类问题分类法……
tldr: MASTA是一个多智能体系统，通过操作-评估角色分解、基于Tamarin验证器反馈的调度仲裁机制和问题分类修改列表，实现了从自然语言协议描述到Tamarin形式化模型的端到端自动建模与分析。
en_tdlr: MASTA is a multi-agent system that achieves end-to-end Tamarin modeling and analysis from natural-language protocol descriptions through operational-evaluative role decomposition, a Tamarin-anchored feedback scheduler, and problem-tagged modification routing.
